title: Watching the shop with cameras and guards
target: How to use the security cameras and the guard in Supermarket Simulator, given that the cameras are objects you place and a manager keeps, and the guard works through patrol, guard and chase states.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop with goods worth watching
Money for cameras and a guard
An idea of where thieves actually go

steps.do: Place cameras as objects rather than hoping a setting covers the shop.
steps.because: the game ships security cameras you place in the shop (SecurityCamera, SecurityCameraVisible)

steps.do: Expect the cameras to be held together in one place.
steps.because: the shop's cameras are held together by a manager of their own (CCTVManager)

steps.do: Remember that a camera keeps a saved record, so where you put it persists.
steps.because: a camera has an interaction and its own saved record (SecurityCameraInteraction, SecurityCameraSaveData)

steps.do: Let the guard walk the shop: he has patrol, guard and chase states of his own.
steps.because: a guard patrols through modes and states of its own, including a patrol mode, a guard mode and a chase state (PatrolMode, GuardMode, ChaseState)

steps.do: Fit the door detector that goes with the security kit.
steps.because: the game ships its own icon for the door detector that works with the shop's security (T_Icon_ThiefDetector)

commonMistakes: Buying cameras and never checking what they actually look at.
Expecting the guard to chase before a patrol is set up.
Forgetting that cameras are saved with the shop, so moving one is a job rather than a drag.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
